paper.core_task: Enhancing multiturn human-LLM collaboration for long-term interaction optimization

contributions.name: A multiturn-aware reward framework for LLM collaboration
contributions.author_claim_text: We introduce COLLABLLM, a novel and general training framework that enhances multiturn human-LLM collaboration. Its key innovation is a collaborative simulation that estimates the long-term contribution of responses using Multiturn-aware Rewards.
contributions.description: A training framework that uses forward sampling to estimate the long-term impact of model responses on future conversation turns, enabling reinforcement fine-tuning for proactive, goal-aligned collaboration.

contributions.name: A multiturn interaction benchmark with three challenging tasks
contributions.author_claim_text: We also devise a multiturn interaction benchmark with three challenging tasks such as document creation.
contributions.description: A benchmark for training and evaluating multiturn collaboration across three domains: document creation, code generation, and math problem solving.

contributions.name: A user simulator for scalable forward sampling
contributions.author_claim_text: To further reduce cost and ensure scalability, we introduce a user simulator U. User Simulator: A user simulator U: T -> U is a function that maps a given conversation history t in T to a user response u in
contributions.description: A method to simulate user behavior using an LLM, enabling the generation of forward conversation trajectories for efficient estimation of the multiturn-aware reward without costly human interaction.

novelty_claims.text: The paper presents a clear and novel methodological contribution through the introduction of the Multiturn-aware Reward (MR) mechanism, which addresses a critical limitation of existing LLMs in handling long-term, open-ended interactions.
